statements.attributed: provides 3D quantitative information on constituent elements including Li ions with a sensitivity of ~10 parts per million
statements.quote: To achieve this aim, we employed STEM, which reveals the atomic arrangements, together with atom probe tomography (APT) at the same location, which provides 3D quantitative information on the constituent elements, including Li ions, with a sensitivity of ~10 parts per million.

statements.quote: Although this study does not clarify the detailed relationship between the arrangement of atomic defects and Li accommodation sites, we could conclude that these defects change the local atomic arrangement and hence the lattice strain, and eventually the distribution of Li.
